sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: It was still dark on the morning of Monday, November 15, 2004, when the alarm clock rang next to Peter Porco's bedside.
sentences.zh: 2004年11月15日，星期一，清晨时分天色尚暗，彼得·波尔科床头的闹钟响了。

sentences.en: The 52-year-old stirred, before leaning over to silence the alarm so it wouldn't wake his wife, Joan, who was sleeping beside him.
sentences.zh: 52岁的彼得翻了个身，俯身关掉闹钟，以免吵醒睡在身边的妻子琼。

sentences.en: A chill greeted Peter as he lifted himself out of bed, so he pulled on a sweater before heading down the hallway to the main bathroom.
sentences.zh: 彼得起床时感到一阵寒意，于是披上一件毛衣，沿着走廊走向主卫。

sentences.en: Peter stood at the vanity and looked at his reflection in the mirror.
sentences.zh: 彼得站在梳妆台前，看着镜子里的自己。

sentences.en: His eyes lowered to the sink in front of him, where he noticed several drops of blood.
sentences.zh: 他的目光下移到面前的洗手池，发现了几滴血迹。

sentences.en: He collected a handful of tissues and attempted to clean the mess.
sentences.zh: 他抓起一把纸巾，试图清理干净。

sentences.en: The blood smeared across the porcelain, but didn't wipe away completely.
sentences.zh: 血迹在瓷面上抹开了，但没能完全擦掉。

sentences.en: Peter gave up and left the tissues in the sink.
sentences.zh: 彼得放弃了，把纸巾留在了洗手池里。

sentences.en: He then went downstairs to the kitchen to prepare for work.
sentences.zh: 随后，他下楼走进厨房，准备上班。

sentences.en: Peter thumbed through some mail, unloaded the dishwasher, and took some food out of the fridge to make his lunch.
sentences.zh: 彼得翻看了邮件，清空了洗碗机，又从冰箱里拿出食物准备午餐。

sentences.en: As he went about his morning routine, Peter kept noticing drops of blood everywhere he went.
sentences.zh: 在进行晨间例行公事时，彼得不断发现自己所到之处都有血滴。

sentences.en: Some he attempted to wipe up with tissues, others he left altogether.
sentences.zh: 有些他试图用纸巾擦掉，有些则干脆没管。

sentences.en: Peter then headed outside to collect the daily newspaper that had been delivered to his front porch.
sentences.zh: 接着，彼得走到屋外去取放在前廊的日报。

sentences.en: As he stepped out to grab it, the front door shut behind him and locked him out.
sentences.zh: 当他走出去拿报纸时，前门在他身后关上并锁住了。

sentences.en: This wasn't a problem, as there was a spare key underneath a flowerpot by the door.
sentences.zh: 这本不是问题，因为门边的花盆下藏着一把备用钥匙。

sentences.en: As Peter retrieved the key and used it to re-enter the house, large droplets of blood dotted the porch steps.
sentences.zh: 当彼得取回钥匙并开门重新进入屋内时，门廊台阶上已经布满了大滴的血迹。

sentences.en: He left the key in the lock and let the door close behind him, though it remained slightly ajar.
sentences.zh: 他把钥匙留在锁孔里，让门在他身后关上，但门依然虚掩着。

sentences.en: Peter took a few steps back towards the kitchen, but was unable to stand upright any longer.
sentences.zh: 彼得向厨房方向走了几步，却再也无法站直身体。

sentences.en: Peter and Joan Porco lived a simple and happy life in Delmar, a suburb approximately 150 miles north of New York City.
sentences.zh: 彼得·波尔科和琼·波尔科在纽约市以北约150英里的德尔马郊区过着简单幸福的生活。

sentences.en: They took great pride in their cream and olive weatherboard home, which Joan kept spotless and organised.
sentences.zh: 他们对那栋奶油色和橄榄色的木板房引以为傲，琼总是把家里打理得一尘不染、井井有条。

sentences.en: The Porcos treated their jobs with equal care and respect.
sentences.zh: 波尔科夫妇对待工作也同样认真负责。

sentences.en: Both were aged in their fifties and had worked in their respective fields for decades.
sentences.zh: 两人都已年过五旬，在各自的领域工作了几十年。

sentences.en: Joan as a speech pathologist for a local elementary school, and Peter as a law clerk at the New York Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 琼是当地一所小学的言语病理学家，彼得则是纽约最高法院的一名书记员。

sentences.en: Peter, who was known as Gentle Peter around the courthouse, had never missed a shift without informing his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 彼得在法院被称为“温和的彼得”，他从未在未通知同事的情况下缺勤。

sentences.en: So, on November 15, 2004, when he failed to show up for work without explanation, concerns grew.
sentences.zh: 因此，2004年11月15日，当他无故缺勤时，大家开始感到担忧。

sentences.en: Calls were placed to the Porcos' family home, but there was no answer.
sentences.zh: 人们拨打了波尔科家的电话，但无人接听。

sentences.en: Peter's workmate, Michael, headed to the residence to make sure everything was alright.
sentences.zh: 彼得的同事迈克尔前往住处查看情况。

sentences.en: Michael drove down the quiet and leafy Broccoli Drive and pulled up in front of the Porcos' two-storey house.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔驱车驶入安静且绿树成荫的西兰花大道，停在波尔科家那栋两层小楼前。

sentences.en: From the street, everything appeared to be in order.
sentences.zh: 从街上看，一切似乎都很正常。

sentences.en: Michael pulled out his cell phone and dialed the Porcos' home number twice, but nothing stirred within the house.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔掏出手机拨打了两次波尔科家的电话，但屋内毫无动静。

sentences.en: Michael then called his boss, who encouraged him to go up and knock on the front door.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔随后致电老板，老板鼓励他上前敲门看看。

sentences.en: Michael kept his boss on the line as he headed up the driveway, and immediately realised something was amiss.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔一边保持通话，一边走上车道，立刻意识到不对劲。

sentences.en: The front door was slightly ajar and a key had been left in the lock.
sentences.zh: 前门虚掩着，钥匙还插在锁孔里。

sentences.en: Worse still, a large smear of blood was visible on the doorknob, and several droplets were splattered around the porch.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，门把手上有一大片明显的血迹，门廊周围也溅落着几滴血。

sentences.en: Michael could hear the Porcos' pet golden retriever barking from somewhere inside.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔能听到波尔科家养的金毛寻回犬在屋内某处吠叫。

sentences.en: He asked his boss whether he should go in, and was told to enter with caution.
sentences.zh: 他询问老板是否应该进去，老板叮嘱他要小心行事。

sentences.en: Michael carefully peered into the foyer, before informing his boss.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔小心翼翼地窥视门厅，随后向老板汇报了情况。

sentences.en: At the base of the stairs, Peter Porco was lying motionless on the tiled floor, his eyes open and glazed.
sentences.zh: 在楼梯底部，彼得·波尔科一动不动地躺在瓷砖地板上，双眼圆睁，目光呆滞。

sentences.en: Blood from a severe head injury had soaked his clothes and was smeared all around him, including along the walls and on some interior doors.
sentences.zh: 严重的头部伤口流出的血浸透了他的衣服，周围到处都是血迹，墙壁和一些室内门上也沾满了血。

sentences.en: Someone had walked through the blood, leaving red footprints throughout the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 有人曾踩着血迹走过，在犯罪现场留下了红色的脚印。

sentences.en: Paramedic Kevin Robert was driving his ambulance in a nearby street when he received a call notifying him of the situation unfolding on Broccoli Drive.
sentences.zh: 急救人员凯文·罗伯特当时正驾驶救护车在附近街道行驶，接到了通知西兰花大道突发状况的电话。

sentences.en: He reached the Porco house and was summoned to the first floor by a detective who had arrived minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 他赶到波尔科家，被几分钟前到达的一名侦探叫到了二楼。

sentences.en: Kevin carefully stepped around Peter Porco's lifeless body, ascended the stairs, and entered the main bedroom.
sentences.zh: 凯文小心地绕过彼得·波尔科毫无生气的尸体，走上楼梯，进入主卧。

sentences.en: Inside, Joan Porco was lying horizontally across a blood-soaked bed.
sentences.zh: 屋内，琼·波尔科横躺在浸透鲜血的床上。

sentences.en: The walls above her were splattered in blood, as were the bedside tables.
sentences.zh: 她上方的墙壁和床头柜上都溅满了血迹。

sentences.en: Joan's upper arms and hands had lacerations indicative of defensive wounds.
sentences.zh: 琼的上臂和手上有明显的防御性伤口。

sentences.en: But it was her head that had bore the brunt of the attack.
sentences.zh: 但她的头部才是遭受攻击最严重的部位。

sentences.en: One of her eyes was split in half and the side of her jaw was hanging from her face.
sentences.zh: 她的一只眼睛裂成两半，半边下巴悬挂在脸上。

sentences.en: Joan had been struck three times to her face and head while she was sleeping.
sentences.zh: 琼在睡梦中面部和头部被击中了三次。

sentences.en: The direction of the cast-off indicated only one assailant had carried out the violent assault.
sentences.zh: 血迹飞溅的方向表明只有一名袭击者实施了这次暴力袭击。

sentences.en: Lying at the foot of the bed was an axe covered in blood.
sentences.zh: 床脚躺着一把沾满鲜血的斧头。

sentences.en: The assailant had unleashed the same axe on Peter Porco a total of 16 times.
sentences.zh: 袭击者用同一把斧头对彼得·波尔科发起了总共16次攻击。

sentences.en: As this was 13 more hits than his wife, it appeared as though Peter was the intended victim.
sentences.zh: 这比他妻子的伤口多了13处，看来彼得才是预定的受害者。

sentences.en: Judging by the amount of blood trailed throughout the house, it was initially thought that Peter had tried to run from his attacker,
sentences.zh: 从屋内拖曳的血迹来看，起初人们认为彼得曾试图逃离袭击者，

sentences.en: who chased him and hit him repeatedly until he collapsed.
sentences.zh: 而袭击者对他穷追不舍，反复击打直到他倒下。

sentences.en: But the bloody footprints throughout the house only belonged to Peter.
sentences.zh: 但屋内所有的血脚印都属于彼得。

sentences.en: He wasn't being pursued by anyone.
sentences.zh: 并没有人在追赶他。

sentences.en: A medical examiner was able to shed light on the bizarre scenario that took place in the house that morning.
sentences.zh: 法医能够揭示那天早上屋内发生的离奇情景。

sentences.en: An autopsy showed that Peter had sustained severe damage to part of the brain responsible for higher order functions, such as perception, decision-making and language.
sentences.zh: 尸检显示，彼得大脑中负责高级功能（如感知、决策和语言）的部分受到了严重损伤。

sentences.en: However, the part of the brain that controls primal instinct and well-formed habits was undamaged.
sentences.zh: 然而，控制原始本能和习惯性行为的大脑部分却未受损。

sentences.en: What actually happened was that, like his wife, Peter was set upon while in bed.
sentences.zh: 事实是，他和妻子一样，是在床上遭到袭击的。

sentences.en: The killer had fled after carrying out the attack, unaware that Peter was still alive.
sentences.zh: 凶手在实施攻击后逃离，并不知道彼得还活着。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Peter awoke to the sound of his alarm clock.
sentences.zh: 不久后，彼得被闹钟声惊醒。

sentences.en: The part of his brain that would otherwise perceive his injured state was too damaged to function properly.
sentences.zh: 他大脑中本该感知到自己受伤状态的部分受损严重，无法正常工作。

sentences.en: So, even when he stared at his caved-in skull in the bathroom mirror and began cleaning up his own dripping blood,
sentences.zh: 所以，即使当他在浴室镜子里盯着自己凹陷的头骨，并开始清理自己滴落的血迹时，

sentences.en: Peter was unable to comprehend that he was critically hurt and needed urgent medical attention.
sentences.zh: 彼得也无法理解自己已身受重伤，需要紧急医疗救助。

sentences.en: However, his brain was still functioning in some capacity, allowing him to carry out his morning routine on instinct alone until he succumbed to blood loss.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的大脑仍有部分功能在运作，让他仅凭本能完成了晨间例行公事，直到最终因失血过多而倒下。

sentences.en: This was not the first time that Detective Chris Bowdish had attended the Porco House.
sentences.zh: 这并不是克里斯·鲍迪什侦探第一次来到波尔科家。

sentences.en: Almost two years prior, he was called to the address following reports of a burglary.
sentences.zh: 大约两年前，他曾因接到入室盗窃的报案来到这里。

sentences.en: Peter and Joan had been awaiting the detective on their front porch.
sentences.zh: 当时彼得和琼正在前廊等候侦探。

sentences.en: They were stressed, having just discovered that two laptops had been stolen from their house.
sentences.zh: 他们当时压力很大，因为刚发现家里有两台笔记本电脑被盗。

sentences.en: The offender had seemingly gained access via the garage window by opening its frame and cutting through its mesh screen in a semi-circular manner.
sentences.zh: 罪犯似乎是通过车库窗户进入的，他打开窗框，并以半圆形方式割开了纱窗。

sentences.en: Lack of evidence prevented any arrests for the break-in, but it did prompt Peter and Joan to bolt the window shut and install a home security system.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏证据，那次入室盗窃案未能逮捕任何人，但这促使彼得和琼将窗户锁死并安装了家庭安防系统。

sentences.en: In a town with a low crime rate, the burglary had stuck in Detective Bowdish's mind,
sentences.zh: 在一个犯罪率很低的城镇，这起盗窃案一直留在鲍迪什侦探的脑海中，

sentences.en: and when Peter and Joan were found brutally attacked, he suspected a link between the two incidents.
sentences.zh: 当彼得和琼被发现遭到残忍袭击时，他怀疑这两起事件之间存在联系。

sentences.en: In both cases, the mesh screen of a window leading to the garage had been cut in a similar semi-circular manner.
sentences.zh: 在这两起案件中，通往车库的窗户纱网都以类似的半圆形方式被割开。

sentences.en: But during the murders, the intruder had also cut the home's phone line.
sentences.zh: 但在谋杀案中，入侵者还切断了家里的电话线。

sentences.en: They also smashed the LCD screen of the security system in the foyer.
sentences.zh: 他们还砸碎了门厅安防系统的液晶显示屏。

sentences.en: Only a single foreign fingerprint was found at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 犯罪现场只发现了一枚外人的指纹。

sentences.en: It was uncovered on the door leading to the basement, where the couple's dog had been locked away.
sentences.zh: 它是在通往地下室的门上发现的，那对夫妇的狗当时被关在那里。

sentences.en: Not even the murder weapon contained any foreign DNA or prints.
sentences.zh: 甚至连凶器上都没有发现任何外人的DNA或指纹。

sentences.en: It was clear the killer had been cautious not to leave behind any evidence that could result in them being identified.
sentences.zh: 很明显，凶手非常谨慎，没有留下任何可能导致其身份暴露的证据。

sentences.en: But to assume this was a burglary gone wrong didn't quite add up.
sentences.zh: 但如果认为这是一起入室盗窃失控导致的案件，逻辑上又说不通。

sentences.en: Everything in the house was in its usual place, and nothing had been rummaged or rifled through.
sentences.zh: 屋里的一切都在原位，没有任何被翻动或搜查的痕迹。

sentences.en: Joan's purse, complete with credit cards, was lying untouched in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 琼的钱包里装着信用卡，完好无损地放在厨房里。

sentences.en: Aside from the bloodstains, the house was in pristine condition.
sentences.zh: 除了血迹，房子保持着原始状态。

sentences.en: It appeared a far more sinister motive than robbery was at play this time.
sentences.zh: 看来这次的作案动机比抢劫要险恶得多。

sentences.en: The intimacy of the crime, from the choice of murder weapon to the victim's wounds being centred around the head, indicated something more personal prompted the attack.
sentences.zh: 犯罪的亲密性，从凶器的选择到受害者伤口集中在头部，表明袭击是由更私人的原因引发的。

sentences.en: Years earlier, Peter had been working as an appellate judge when he received a death threat from a man who was given an unfavourable ruling.
sentences.zh: 多年前，彼得在担任上诉法官时，曾收到一名因判决不利而心怀不满的男子的死亡威胁。

sentences.en: Peter took the threat seriously and obtained a handgun for protection.
sentences.zh: 彼得认真对待了这一威胁，并买了一把手枪防身。

sentences.en: He kept it by his bedside table.
sentences.zh: 他把枪放在床头柜旁。

sentences.en: But as time passed and no action was taken against him, his worries dissipated.
sentences.zh: 但随着时间推移，对方没有采取任何行动，他的担忧也随之消散。

sentences.en: Eventually, Peter stored the gun away in a closet.
sentences.zh: 最终，彼得把枪收进了壁橱里。

sentences.en: Following the murders, the man who had made the death threat was tracked down, but cleared from the investigation after providing a solid alibi.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生后，警方追踪到了那名发出死亡威胁的男子，但他提供了确凿的不在场证明，从而排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Peter also had unlikely ties to the criminal underworld in that his great uncle, Frank Porco, was a known New York mobster.
sentences.zh: 彼得与犯罪黑社会也有着意想不到的联系，他的叔祖父弗兰克·波尔科是纽约知名的黑帮成员。

sentences.en: 30 years prior, Frank had arrived at Peter and Joan's wedding dripping in gold jewellery, flaunting large amounts of cash, and had a revolver strapped to his leg.
sentences.zh: 30年前，弗兰克参加彼得和琼的婚礼时，浑身挂满金饰，大肆炫耀现金，腿上还绑着一把左轮手枪。

sentences.en: There were rumours that Frank had snitched on his fellow mobsters, leading to the belief that Peter and Joan could have been targeted in retribution.
sentences.zh: 有传言称弗兰克曾向黑帮同伙告密，因此有人认为彼得和琼可能是遭到了报复。

sentences.en: This theory was bolstered by the fact that the perpetrator had used a fireman's axe,
sentences.zh: 这一理论因作案者使用了消防斧而得到加强，

sentences.en: which was symbolic, given that Frank Porco was known within criminal circles as Frankie the Fireman.
sentences.zh: 考虑到弗兰克·波尔科在犯罪圈内被称为“消防员弗兰基”，这似乎具有象征意义。

sentences.en: However, further examination of the axe revealed that it was not a fireman's axe as initially believed,
sentences.zh: 然而，对斧头的进一步检查显示，它并非最初认为的消防斧，

sentences.en: but a regular one taken from the Porco's garage that they had purchased at a local hardware store.
sentences.zh: 而是一把从波尔科家车库里拿走的普通斧头，是他们从当地五金店买的。

sentences.en: Additionally, Frank Porco had children, so it didn't make sense that anyone wishing to send him a cruel message would target his great-nephew instead.
sentences.zh: 此外，弗兰克·波尔科有孩子，如果有人想给他传达残酷的信息，针对他的侄孙显然说不通。

sentences.en: Frank also had a history of refusing to cooperate with authorities, casting doubts that he was an informer.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克还有拒绝与当局合作的记录，这让人怀疑他是否真的是告密者。

sentences.en: The theory that Frank Porco was in some way responsible for the attack on Peter and Joan just didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·波尔科以某种方式对彼得和琼的袭击负责的理论根本站不住脚。

sentences.en: Then, a month after the axe attack, an envelope arrived at the headquarters of the Times Union newspaper in Albany, a city north of Delmar.
sentences.zh: 随后，在斧头袭击案发生一个月后，德尔马以北城市奥尔巴尼的《时代联合报》总部收到了一封信。

sentences.en: As an employee handled it, a fine white powder poured out from one of the corners.
sentences.zh: 当一名员工处理信件时，细细的白色粉末从一个角落洒了出来。

sentences.en: They immediately notified the police.
sentences.zh: 他们立即通知了警方。

sentences.en: Inside was a letter from someone claiming responsibility for Peter Porco's death, and stating that he was a starting point.
sentences.zh: 信中有人声称对彼得·波尔科的死负责，并称他只是一个起点。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 信中写道：

sentences.en: Peter was not even a challenge.
sentences.zh: 彼得甚至算不上一个挑战。

sentences.en: Once I got inside, I repeatedly hit him in the head and neck with a small axe.
sentences.zh: 我一进去，就用一把小斧头反复击打他的头部和颈部。

sentences.en: I ignored all his pleading screaMs.
sentences.zh: 我无视了他所有的哀求尖叫。

sentences.en: If you ever want to find me, you might want to stop going after easy suspects.
sentences.zh: 如果你想找到我，最好别再盯着那些容易对付的嫌疑人了。

sentences.en: Show me some respect I deserve.
sentences.zh: 给我应有的尊重。

sentences.en: Catch me if you can.
sentences.zh: 有本事就来抓我。

sentences.en: Tests revealed that the white powder was a non-harmful substance.
sentences.zh: 检测显示，白色粉末是一种无害物质。

sentences.en: Analysis of the letter failed to uncover any fingerprints or other characteristics that could help identify its author.
sentences.zh: 对信件的分析未能发现任何有助于识别作者的指纹或其他特征。

sentences.en: A police lieutenant told the media he wouldn't classify the letter as a break in the case, rather just another avenue they were investigating.
sentences.zh: 一名警督告诉媒体，他不会将这封信归类为案件的突破口，而只是他们正在调查的另一条线索。

sentences.en: What the lieutenant didn't disclose was that police had quickly ruled the letter out as a hoax.
sentences.zh: 警督没有透露的是，警方很快就排除了这封信，认为这是一场恶作剧。

sentences.en: They were already zeroing in on who they strongly suspected was responsible for the murders.
sentences.zh: 他们当时已经锁定了他们强烈怀疑的谋杀案嫌疑人。

sentences.en: A person who had been identified by Joan Porco herself.
sentences.zh: 一个被琼·波尔科本人指认的人。

sentences.en: Detective Chris Boudish had been the first officer to arrive to the Porco's house following the discovery of the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·鲍迪什侦探是犯罪现场被发现后第一位到达波尔科家的警官。

sentences.en: He immediately carried out a rudimentary sweep of the downstairs rooMs.
sentences.zh: 他立即对楼下房间进行了初步搜查。

sentences.en: While he didn't come across any intruders, he found the Porco's pet dog locked in the basement.
sentences.zh: 虽然他没有遇到任何入侵者，但他发现波尔科家的宠物狗被关在地下室里。

sentences.en: Boudish then headed up to the first floor to canvas the rooms there.
sentences.zh: 鲍迪什随后前往二楼，对那里的房间进行勘查。

sentences.en: He arrived at the main bedroom to find the badly beaten body of Joan Porco.
sentences.zh: 他来到主卧，发现了被打得遍体鳞伤的琼·波尔科。

sentences.en: Shockingly, Joan's hand weakly raised into the air.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的是，琼的手无力地举向空中。

sentences.en: Not only was she still alive, but she was still conscious.
sentences.zh: 她不仅还活着，而且意识清醒。

sentences.en: She motioned for Boudish to enter.
sentences.zh: 她示意鲍迪什靠近。

sentences.en: He asked if she could hear him.
sentences.zh: 他问她是否能听到他说话。

sentences.en: Although Joan was unable to speak due to her injuries, she was able to communicate by nodding and shaking her head.
sentences.zh: 尽管琼因伤无法说话，但她能够通过点头和摇头进行交流。

sentences.en: Fearing Joan would pass away before paramedics arrived,
sentences.zh: 担心琼会在医护人员到达前离世，

sentences.en: Detective Boudish began asking her questions in a desperate bid to gather key evidence.
sentences.zh: 鲍迪什侦探开始向她提问，试图获取关键证据。

sentences.en: He asked if a family member had done this to her.
sentences.zh: 他问是不是家庭成员对她做了这种事。

sentences.en: Joan nodded.
sentences.zh: 琼点了点头。

sentences.en: He asked if it was Jonathan.
sentences.zh: 他问是不是乔纳森。

sentences.en: Joan motioned with her hand.
sentences.zh: 琼用手势示意。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: Detective Boudish then asked if her other, younger son, Christopher, was responsible.
sentences.zh: 鲍迪什侦探随后问她另一个小儿子克里斯托弗是否是凶手。

sentences.en: Joan nodded.
sentences.zh: 琼点了点头。

sentences.en: Boudish repeated the question.
sentences.zh: 鲍迪什重复了这个问题。

sentences.en: Again, Joan signalled yes.
sentences.zh: 琼再次示意是肯定的。

sentences.en: At 2.45 that afternoon, a reporter for the Times Union newspaper placed a call to the University of Rochester in West New York State.
sentences.zh: 当天下午2点45分，《时代联合报》的一名记者拨通了位于纽约州西部的罗切斯特大学的电话。

sentences.en: 21-year-old Christopher Porco was enrolled to study biomedical engineering and economics there.
sentences.zh: 21岁的克里斯托弗·波尔科当时在那儿攻读生物医学工程和经济学。

sentences.en: When he answered the call, the reporter asked Chris if he had any comment to give in relation to his parents being killed.
sentences.zh: 当他接起电话时，记者问克里斯对于他父母遇害一事有什么评论。

sentences.en: It was the first Chris had been informed of the attack.
sentences.zh: 这是克里斯第一次得知袭击事件。

sentences.en: He asked the reporter what she was talking about.
sentences.zh: 他问记者在说什么。

sentences.en: She said she couldn't tell him anything and would call him back.
sentences.zh: 她说她不能透露任何信息，稍后会再打给他。

sentences.en: Chris dropped the phone in shock.
sentences.zh: 克里斯震惊得手机都掉在了地上。

sentences.en: He sat around in his dorm room waiting to hear back, but the phone didn't ring.
sentences.zh: 他坐在宿舍里等着回音，但电话一直没响。

sentences.en: After composing himself, he phoned 911 for an explanation.
sentences.zh: 平复心情后，他拨打了911寻求解释。

sentences.en: While the operator tried to ascertain what had happened, Chris received a text from his girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 当接线员试图查明发生了什么事时，克里斯收到了女友发来的短信。

sentences.en: News had spread that his parents' house had been cordoned off with police tape and officials were swarming the area.
sentences.zh: 消息已经传开，他父母的房子被警戒线封锁，官员们正蜂拥而至。

sentences.en: Chris was completely unaware that police had issued an alert to be on the lookout for him, with the report urging officers to use caution as Chris might be armed.
sentences.zh: 克里斯完全不知道警方已经发布了针对他的搜捕令，报告中敦促警员要小心行事，因为克里斯可能持有武器。

sentences.en: An uncle picked Chris up from campus and drove him to Delmar.
sentences.zh: 一位叔叔从校园接上克里斯，开车送他去德尔马。

sentences.en: The near four-hour journey was a solemn one.
sentences.zh: 这段近四个小时的旅程气氛凝重。

sentences.en: Chris, dazed and visibly shaken, stared out the passenger window, barely speaking a word.
sentences.zh: 克里斯神情恍惚，明显受到惊吓，他盯着副驾驶窗外，几乎一言不发。

sentences.en: Paramedics fought hard to save Joan Porco, but had trouble placing an oxygen mask over her mouth and nose as they couldn't make out her facial features.
sentences.zh: 医护人员竭尽全力抢救琼·波尔科，但由于无法辨认她的面部特征，很难将氧气面罩戴在她的口鼻上。

sentences.en: Her blood pressure was almost non-existent and brain matter was visible through the wounds in her skull.
sentences.zh: 她的血压几乎测不到，颅骨上的伤口甚至能看到脑组织。

sentences.en: She was rushed to hospital to undergo emergency surgery, but the situation was dire.
sentences.zh: 她被紧急送往医院进行手术，但情况十分危急。

sentences.en: Chris Porco arrived at the hospital while his mother was undergoing treatment.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·波尔科在母亲接受治疗时赶到了医院。

sentences.en: He was immediately swarmed and hugged by friends and relatives who had gathered in the waiting room awaiting news of Joan's state.
sentences.zh: 他立刻被聚集在候诊室等待琼消息的亲友团团围住并拥抱。

sentences.en: At one stage, a family friend broke the news to Chris that he was a suspect in the attack.
sentences.zh: 期间，一位家庭朋友向克里斯透露，他是这起袭击案的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Shocked, Chris asked how anyone could think he would hurt his parents.
sentences.zh: 克里斯大为震惊，质问怎么会有人认为他会伤害自己的父母。

sentences.en: Peter and Joan Porco were a loving couple who made sure that their children never went without.
sentences.zh: 彼得和琼·波尔科是一对恩爱的夫妻，他们确保孩子们从不缺衣少食。

sentences.en: By 2004, the Porcos were empty nesters, though remained close to both their sons, Jonathan and Christopher.
sentences.zh: 到2004年，波尔科夫妇已是空巢老人，但与两个儿子乔纳森和克里斯托弗依然亲密。

sentences.en: Christopher had inherited his father's looks and magnetic, sociable personality.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗继承了他父亲的长相，以及那种富有感染力的社交个性。

sentences.en: Described as a popular and charming person who was always smiling, Chris was also intelligent, scoring in the top 95 percentile nationally following his high school graduation.
sentences.zh: 克里斯被描述为一个总是面带微笑、受欢迎且迷人的人，他也很聪明，高中毕业后在全国统考中名列前95%的顶尖行列。

sentences.en: A member of the local church youth group, his university swim team, and a former vet technician,
sentences.zh: 作为当地教会青年团、大学游泳队的一员，还曾是一名兽医技术员，

sentences.en: Chris was a hard worker with many interests.
sentences.zh: 克里斯工作努力，兴趣广泛。

sentences.en: To friends, Chris had no discernible reason to murder his parents.
sentences.zh: 在朋友们看来，克里斯没有任何理由去谋杀他的父母。

sentences.en: He spoke positively of his affluent childhood and took his friends on driving tours of his old neighbourhood to point out the mansion he'd grown up in.
sentences.zh: 他经常谈起自己富裕的童年，还会带朋友开车参观他以前住的社区，指着他长大的豪宅给他们看。

sentences.en: In fact, Chris was so well off that he'd let it slip that he had 2.8 million dollars in a trust account held in the Cayman Islands.
sentences.zh: 事实上，克里斯非常富有，他曾无意中透露自己在开曼群岛的一个信托账户里有280万美元。

sentences.en: He'd also purchased an impressive home in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 他还在北卡罗来纳州买了一套令人印象深刻的房子。

sentences.en: He happily shared his wealth, showering his friends with gifts and shouting them drinks from a stockpile of cash he always kept on him.
sentences.zh: 他乐于分享财富，总是用随身携带的现金给朋友买礼物、请客喝酒。

sentences.en: However, it hadn't always been smooth sailing for Chris Porco.
sentences.zh: 然而，克里斯·波尔科的生活并非一帆风顺。

sentences.en: In 2002, a prolonged bout of glandular fever caused him a temporary setback.
sentences.zh: 2002年，一场长期的腺热让他经历了一次暂时的挫折。

sentences.en: But, with the unwavering support and help of his parents, he was able to recover and return to his studies.
sentences.zh: 但是，在父母坚定不移的支持和帮助下，他得以康复并重返学业。

sentences.en: Joan would make the seven hour round trip to Rochester whenever she could to look after Chris during his recovery.
sentences.zh: 琼在克里斯康复期间，只要有机会就会往返七小时车程去罗切斯特照顾他。

sentences.en: It was clear to all those who knew Peter and Joan Porco that they loved their children.
sentences.zh: 所有认识彼得和琼·波尔科的人都清楚，他们深爱着自己的孩子。

sentences.en: When Chris saw the swollen and maimed state his mother was in following the axe attack, he burst into tears and fell to the floor.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯看到母亲在斧头袭击后肿胀残缺的样子时，他泪如雨下，瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: As Joan was taken into surgery, Chris was met by a detective and agreed to go to the police station for questioning.
sentences.zh: 当琼被送进手术室时，克里斯遇到了一名侦探，并同意去警察局接受询问。

sentences.en: Throughout the interrogation, Chris was polite and cooperative.
sentences.zh: 在整个审讯过程中，克里斯表现得礼貌且配合。

sentences.en: Although he returned to Delmar periodically to visit his parents, he hadn't stayed with them for three weeks.
sentences.zh: 虽然他偶尔会回德尔马探望父母，但他已经有三周没和他们住在一起了。

sentences.en: He denied involvement in the brutal attack and provided an alibi for the night in question.
sentences.zh: 他否认参与了这起残忍的袭击，并为案发当晚提供了不在场证明。

sentences.en: At 9.30pm, Chris went out to dinner with a friend in Rochester before returning to the on-campus dormitory where he lived.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点30分，克里斯在罗切斯特和朋友出去吃晚饭，然后回到了他居住的校内宿舍。

sentences.en: He exchanged online messages with his girlfriend, then settled into the dorm's common room to watch a movie.
sentences.zh: 他和女友交换了在线消息，然后坐在宿舍公共休息室看电影。

sentences.en: It went on into the early hours, during which Chris fell asleep on the sofa.
sentences.zh: 电影一直放到凌晨，期间克里斯在沙发上睡着了。

sentences.en: He was still sleeping there when another student entered at 10am the following morning.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上10点，另一名学生进来时，他还在那里睡觉。

sentences.en: Chris had nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 克里斯没什么可隐瞒的。

sentences.en: He let police take his fingerprints and blood for testing.
sentences.zh: 他让警察采集了他的指纹和血液进行化验。

sentences.en: When asked to lift his shirt so they could check for superficial injuries that might indicate his involvement in the attack, Chris was happy to do so.
sentences.zh: 当被要求掀起衬衫以检查是否有表明他参与袭击的浅表伤痕时，克里斯很乐意配合。

sentences.en: He also supplied the clothing he was wearing so it could undergo analysis.
sentences.zh: 他还提供了他当时穿的衣服以便进行分析。

sentences.en: His car was also seized.
sentences.zh: 他的车也被扣押了。

sentences.en: Yet, neither his vehicle nor his clothes contained blood or hair from either one of his parents, as would be expected from such a violent crime.
sentences.zh: 然而，他的车和衣服上都没有他父母任何一人的血迹或毛发，而这种暴力犯罪通常会留下这些痕迹。

sentences.en: Despite his cooperation, Chris sensed the police were convinced he was guilty.
sentences.zh: 尽管他很配合，但克里斯感觉到警察认定他有罪。

sentences.en: Peter and Joan's eldest son, 23-year-old Jonathan, was away on assignment with the US Navy at the time, so as far as police were concerned, there weren't any other viable suspects.
sentences.zh: 彼得和琼的长子，23岁的乔纳森当时正在美国海军服役，所以就警方而言，没有其他可疑人选。

sentences.en: For Chris, his interrogators seemed to be getting angrier and angrier as the hours passed.
sentences.zh: 对克里斯来说，审讯人员似乎随着时间的推移变得越来越愤怒。

sentences.en: They accused him over and over, to the point that he became afraid of them.
sentences.zh: 他们反复指控他，以至于他开始害怕他们。

sentences.en: He continued to help investigators but was rattled by their unwavering suspicion.
sentences.zh: 他继续协助调查人员，但被他们坚定不移的怀疑所动摇。

sentences.en: He agreed to participate in a polygraph test but refused to do so without an attorney present.
sentences.zh: 他同意参加测谎仪测试，但拒绝在没有律师在场的情况下进行。

sentences.en: This request, along with his right to legal counsel during his interrogation, was denied.
sentences.zh: 这一请求，连同他在审讯期间获得法律顾问的权利，都被拒绝了。

sentences.en: Chris wasn't even read his full Miranda rights.
sentences.zh: 克里斯甚至没有被宣读完整的米兰达权利。

sentences.en: Instead, he was forced to sign a copy that he didn't have time to read.
sentences.zh: 相反，他被迫签署了一份他根本没时间阅读的副本。

sentences.en: After six hours, Chris was finally permitted to leave the police station.
sentences.zh: 六小时后，克里斯终于被允许离开警察局。

sentences.en: He returned to the hospital to check on his mother.
sentences.zh: 他回到医院查看母亲的情况。

sentences.en: Against all odds,
sentences.zh: 在所有不利的情况下，

sentences.en: Joan Porco survived her 12-hour surgery and was placed into a medically induced coma, though doctors didn't expect her to recover.
sentences.zh: 琼·波尔科在12小时的手术中幸存下来，并被置于药物诱导的昏迷状态，尽管医生并不认为她能康复。

sentences.en: A priest read Joan her last rites in anticipation of her death.
sentences.zh: 一位牧师为琼做了临终祈祷，预料她将不久于人世。

sentences.en: Three weeks later,
sentences.zh: 三周后，

sentences.en: Joan Porco miraculously awoke.
sentences.zh: 琼·波尔科奇迹般地醒了过来。

sentences.en: She had lost her left eye, part of her skull had been removed, and her face was permanently scarred.
sentences.zh: 她失去了左眼，部分颅骨被切除，脸上留下了永久性的伤疤。

sentences.en: Damage to her throat left her with a quiet, whispering voice.
sentences.zh: 喉咙的损伤使她的声音变得低沉而沙哑。

sentences.en: But, she had survived.
sentences.zh: 但是，她活了下来。

sentences.en: The problem was, Joan had no memory of the attack.
sentences.zh: 问题是，琼对袭击事件毫无记忆。

sentences.en: She remembered what she'd done in the days leading up, such as visiting the YMCA, working in the yard, and going to church, but recalled nothing of November 15.
sentences.zh: 她记得案发前几天做过的事，比如去基督教青年会、在院子里干活、去教堂，但对11月15日发生的事毫无印象。

sentences.en: Most crucially, she couldn't recall identifying her youngest son as her attacker, and denied ever doing so.
sentences.zh: 最关键的是，她不记得曾指认小儿子是袭击者，并否认曾经这样做过。

sentences.en: She knew in her heart that Chris was innocent.
sentences.zh: 她内心深处知道克里斯是无辜的。

sentences.en: Joan did remember a strange incident that occurred two weeks prior.
sentences.zh: 琼确实记得两周前发生的一件奇怪的事。

sentences.en: One night, the motion sensor lights outside the Porcos' home went off.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，波尔科家外面的感应灯亮了。

sentences.en: Joan went to investigate and noticed a shadowy figure loitering in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 琼去查看时，发现车道上有一个黑影在徘徊。

sentences.en: The police, including Detective Bowdish, were informed of the incident, but didn't investigate the matter.
sentences.zh: 包括鲍迪什侦探在内的警方被告知了这件事，但并没有进行调查。

sentences.en: Joan's instincts told her that there was more to this encounter than the police believed.
sentences.zh: 琼的直觉告诉她，这次遭遇并不像警方认为的那么简单。

sentences.en: Yet, they continued to try and convince her of Chris's guilt.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们仍然试图让她相信克里斯有罪。

sentences.en: Joan remained steadfaSt. Chris was not responsible.
sentences.zh: 琼立场坚定：克里斯没有责任。

sentences.en: She wrote a letter to the editor of the Times Union newspaper, which read,
sentences.zh: 她给《时代联合报》的编辑写了一封信，信中写道：

sentences.en: "'Thanks to wonderful doctors, numerous medical treatments and surgeries, I have survived.
sentences.zh: “多亏了出色的医生、众多的医疗和手术，我活了下来。

sentences.en: I continue to improve.
sentences.zh: 我正在持续好转。

sentences.en: And even though I have suffered a grievous injury, both physical and emotional, I thank God for my life.
sentences.zh: 尽管我遭受了严重的身体和情感创伤，但我感谢上帝让我活了下来。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the horror and unbearable sadness I continue to feel as a result of the loss of
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，由于彼得的离世，我感到的恐惧和难以承受的悲伤，

sentences.en: Peter has been dramatically intensified by the trauma that our cherished son, Chris, has been forced to endure.
sentences.zh: 因为我们挚爱的儿子克里斯所被迫承受的创伤而变得更加剧烈。

sentences.en: I want to say, unequivocally, that although I have no memory whatsoever of the attack, either because I
sentences.zh: 我想明确地说，虽然我完全不记得袭击事件，要么是因为我

sentences.en: was asleep or because of my injuries, I am absolutely positive that my son was in no way involved in this heinous crime.
sentences.zh: 当时在睡觉，要么是因为我的伤势，但我绝对肯定我的儿子绝没有参与这起令人发指的罪行。

sentences.en: He is an intelligent, compassionate, peaceful and loving person, and no one could ask for a better son.
sentences.zh: 他是一个聪明、富有同情心、平和且充满爱心的人，没有人能要求更好的儿子了。

sentences.en: He, Peter, our older son Jonathan, and I have always had a wonderful relationship, and Chris would never hurt any one of us.
sentences.zh: 他、彼得、我们的长子乔纳森和我一直保持着美好的关系，克里斯绝不会伤害我们中的任何一个人。

sentences.en: I implore the police and the district attorney's office to leave my son alone, and to search for Peter's real killer or killers, so that he can rest in peace,
sentences.zh: 我恳求警方和地方检察官办公室放过我的儿子，去寻找彼得真正的凶手，让他安息，

sentences.en: and my sons and I can live in safety."
sentences.zh: 并让我和我的儿子们能安全地生活。”

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: My name is Chris Borgo.
sentences.zh: 我叫克里斯·波尔科。

sentences.en: I was just called by the Times Union saying that my parents were found dead this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我刚接到《时代联合报》的电话，说我父母今天下午被发现死亡了。

sentences.en: I was wondering if you had any information for me.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你们是否有关于我的任何信息。

sentences.en: Hey Chris, whereabouts are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，克里斯，你在哪里？

sentences.en: I'm at school in Rochester, New York.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约罗切斯特的学校。

sentences.en: Okay, you're in Rochester?
sentences.zh: 好的，你在罗切斯特？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Do you have a phone number there, Chris?
sentences.zh: 你在那儿有电话号码吗，克里斯？

sentences.en: Yeah, I sure do.
sentences.zh: 有的，当然有。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Are you in a dorm there?
sentences.zh: 你住在宿舍吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我住在那儿。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And you're hearing from the Times Union?
sentences.zh: 你是从《时代联合报》那里听说的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, they called me and said my parents were found, I guess, I don't know, they didn't say how or anything.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们打电话给我说我父母被发现了，我想，我不知道，他们没说怎么发现的或者其他什么。

sentences.en: At around 3pm on November 15, 2004, Chris's girlfriend checked her messages and saw she had a text from him.
sentences.zh: 2004年11月15日下午3点左右，克里斯的女友查看消息时，看到他发来的一条短信。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: My parents are dead.
sentences.zh: 我父母死了。

sentences.en: She had been messaging Chris on and off throughout the day, aware that a situation was unravelling at his parents' place in Delmar.
sentences.zh: 她整天都在和克里斯断断续续地发消息，知道他父母在德尔马的家里出事了。

sentences.en: He had messaged her earlier telling her that he wasn't feeling well and that, quote, he hadn't heard from his parents all morning and that he was nervous.
sentences.zh: 他早些时候给她发过消息，说他感觉不舒服，而且，引用他的话，他整个上午都没收到父母的消息，他很紧张。

sentences.en: Chris didn't message his girlfriend again after revealing that his parents were deceased.
sentences.zh: 克里斯在透露父母去世后，没有再给女友发过消息。

sentences.en: His uncle John picked him up from campus and drove him straight to Delmar.
sentences.zh: 他的叔叔约翰从校园接上他，直接开车送他去德尔马。

sentences.en: As they neared their destination, John received a call from a family friend.
sentences.zh: 当他们接近目的地时，约翰接到了一个家庭朋友的电话。

sentences.en: He had something important to say, but it was imperative that he keep it from Chris.
sentences.zh: 他有重要的事情要说，但必须对克里斯保密。

sentences.en: Chris was a suspect in his parents' attack.
sentences.zh: 克里斯是他父母袭击案的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Chris cooperated with investigators, saying that he wanted to be as helpful as he could so they could find the killer as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 克里斯配合调查人员，说他想尽其所能提供帮助，以便他们能尽快找到凶手。

sentences.en: When asked if he committed the brutal assault, Chris replied,
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否犯下了这起残忍的袭击时，克里斯回答说：

sentences.en: Following Joan Porco's life-saving surgery, Chris stood vigil by her side.
sentences.zh: 在琼·波尔科完成救命手术后，克里斯守在她的床边。

sentences.en: A youth minister comforted him and was struck by Chris's odd behaviour.
sentences.zh: 一位青年牧师安慰他，并对克里斯奇怪的行为感到震惊。

sentences.en: He didn't sense any grief from the young man.
sentences.zh: 他没有从这个年轻人身上感受到任何悲伤。

sentences.en: Just over 200 miles west, detectives were following up Chris's alibi at his dormitory in Rochester.
sentences.zh: 在向西200多英里外，侦探们正在罗切斯特的宿舍核实克里斯的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Chris maintained he was asleep on the common room sofa on the night of the attack.
sentences.zh: 克里斯坚称他在袭击当晚睡在公共休息室的沙发上。

sentences.en: While another student recalled seeing him asleep on the sofa at 10am, no one could vouch for him being there overnight.
sentences.zh: 虽然另一名学生回忆起在早上10点看到他在沙发上睡觉，但没有人能证明他整晚都在那里。

sentences.en: Several other students claimed they had been in the common room until 3.30am and at no time was Chris present.
sentences.zh: 其他几名学生声称他们一直在公共休息室待到凌晨3点30分，克里斯从未出现过。

sentences.en: It was only a small, square room with a few couches and a television, so he would be impossible to miss.
sentences.zh: 那只是一个带几张沙发和一台电视的小方房间，所以他不可能被忽略。

sentences.en: One student assured,
sentences.zh: 一名学生肯定地说：

sentences.en: It's not like maybe he was there and we overlooked him.
sentences.zh: 不是说他可能在那儿而我们没注意到。

sentences.en: He wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 他根本不在那儿。

sentences.en: It was approaching 11 o'clock on the night of November 14, 2004, marking the end of a long shift for toll collector John Fallon.
sentences.zh: 时间接近2004年11月14日晚11点，标志着收费员约翰·法伦漫长轮班的结束。

sentences.en: John stood alone in a booth at the exit 46 tolls in the suburb of Henrietta, just off the New York State Thruway.
sentences.zh: 约翰独自站在纽约州高速公路旁亨利埃塔郊区46号出口的收费亭里。

sentences.en: Craving a cigarette, John discreetly lit one up while keeping an eye out in case his boss suddenly approached.
sentences.zh: 烟瘾犯了，约翰一边留意老板是否突然出现，一边悄悄点了一根烟。

sentences.en: At 10.46pm, a bright yellow Jeep Wrangler caught John's attention.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点46分，一辆亮黄色的吉普牧马人引起了约翰的注意。

sentences.en: He'd been on the lookout for a new car for his son and had always loved Jeeps.
sentences.zh: 他一直在为儿子寻找一辆新车，而且一直很喜欢吉普车。

sentences.en: This one was a particularly nice model and John noted its wide tyres and black canvas top.
sentences.zh: 这一辆是特别好的型号，约翰注意到了它宽大的轮胎和黑色帆布车顶。

sentences.en: It drove through John's toll lane and pulled up to the booth where he was waiting.
sentences.zh: 它穿过约翰的收费车道，停在他等待的收费亭旁。

sentences.en: The driver was a white man aged in his twenties wearing a baseball cap.
sentences.zh: 司机是一名二十多岁的白人男子，戴着棒球帽。

sentences.en: He was travelling alone.
sentences.zh: 他独自一人开车。

sentences.en: Although cashless tolling was available to vehicles that had an electronic EasyPass tag installed, this driver didn't appear to have one.
sentences.zh: 虽然安装了电子EasyPass标签的车辆可以使用无现金收费，但这名司机似乎没有。

sentences.en: Instead, he opted to pay for the toll with cash.
sentences.zh: 相反，他选择用现金支付通行费。

sentences.en: John handed him a ticket, which gave the Jeep access to the New York State Thruway, a system of controlled access highways spanning over 550 miles across the state.
sentences.zh: 约翰递给他一张票，这张票让这辆吉普车可以进入纽约州高速公路系统，这是一个横跨全州550多英里的受控准入高速公路系统。

sentences.en: He then let the Jeep continue onwards, before stubbing out his cigarette and finishing his shift.
sentences.zh: 然后他让吉普车继续前行，随后掐灭了烟头，结束了他的轮班。

sentences.en: Just over three hours later, toll collector Karen Russell was preparing to go on her break.
sentences.zh: 三个多小时后，收费站工作人员凯伦·拉塞尔正准备去休息。

sentences.en: Her booth was located 230 miles west of Henrietta, at exit 24 of Interstate 87, just outside the suburb of Delmar.
sentences.zh: 她的收费亭位于亨丽埃塔以西230英里处，即87号州际公路24号出口，就在德尔马郊区外。

sentences.en: Karen was working the 10pm to 6am shift when at 1.51am she noticed a car speeding down her lane.
sentences.zh: 凯伦当时值的是晚上10点到早上6点的班，凌晨1点51分，她注意到一辆车正飞速驶入她的车道。

sentences.en: It came to an abrupt stop at her booth.
sentences.zh: 车子在她的收费亭前猛地停了下来。

sentences.en: Karen eyed the driver, it was a young man with brown hair.
sentences.zh: 凯伦打量了一下司机，那是一个棕色头发的年轻人。

sentences.en: She collected a toll ticket from him and sent him on his way.
sentences.zh: 她收了他的通行费票据，然后让他离开了。

sentences.en: He hit the accelerator and sped off into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 他猛踩油门，加速冲进了夜色中。

sentences.en: Although Karen ticketed 24 more vehicles before she finally went on her break, she never forgot this one.
sentences.zh: 尽管凯伦在最终去休息前又给24辆车发了票，但她从未忘记这一辆。

sentences.en: Given that the car was travelling so fast and dangerously, Karen remembered the yellow Jeep Wrangler vividly.
sentences.zh: 鉴于那辆车行驶得如此之快且危险，凯伦对那辆黄色吉普牧马人记忆犹新。

sentences.en: Broccoli Drive in Delmar was predictably dark and quiet at 4am on November 15, 2004, when local resident Marshall got in his car to head off for work.
sentences.zh: 2004年11月15日凌晨4点，德尔马的西兰花大道一如既往地黑暗而安静，当地居民马歇尔坐进车里准备去上班。

sentences.en: For a moment, his headlights swept over his neighbour's property.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，他的车灯扫过了邻居的房产。

sentences.en: They illuminated a yellow Jeep Wrangler parked in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 灯光照亮了停在车道上的一辆黄色吉普牧马人。

sentences.en: Marshall had seen the vehicle before, speeding up and down the street with music blaring.
sentences.zh: 马歇尔以前见过这辆车，它经常伴随着震耳欲聋的音乐在街上飞驰。

sentences.en: Although it had caught Marshall's attention as it sat stationary in front of the home belonging to Peter and
sentences.zh: 虽然它停在彼得和琼·波尔科家门前引起了马歇尔的注意，

sentences.en: Joan Porco, it wasn't an unusual sighting.
sentences.zh: 但这并不罕见。

sentences.en: He knew who owned the car.
sentences.zh: 他知道这辆车是谁的。

sentences.en: As such, he thought nothing of it and continued onwards.
sentences.zh: 因此，他没多想就继续前行了。

sentences.en: The sighting of the yellow Jeep in the Porco's driveway at the time of the attack was a crucial one for detectives.
sentences.zh: 在袭击发生时，这辆黄色吉普车出现在波尔科家的车道上，这对侦探们来说是一个关键线索。

sentences.en: They were able to trace its movements through the toll booths, which had been captured on CCTV footage.
sentences.zh: 他们通过闭路电视监控录像追踪到了它在收费站的行踪。

sentences.en: While the footage wasn't clear enough for the Jeep's number plates to be visible, a video analyst was able to enhance the footage enough to notice some clues.
sentences.zh: 虽然录像不够清晰，无法看清吉普车的车牌，但视频分析师通过增强画面发现了一些线索。

sentences.en: Marred on the passenger side door, a torn barcode sticker on the passenger side window, and an oval sticker on the spare tyre cover.
sentences.zh: 乘客侧车门上有划痕，乘客侧车窗上贴着一张撕裂的条形码贴纸，备胎罩上有一个椭圆形贴纸。

sentences.en: There was little doubt at this stage who the car belonged to, but these small details confirmed it.
sentences.zh: 此时，这辆车属于谁已毫无疑问，但这些小细节证实了这一点。

sentences.en: The day after his parents were attacked, Chris Porco's yellow Jeep Wrangler was seized for forensic examination.
sentences.zh: 在父母遇袭的第二天，克里斯·波尔科的黄色吉普牧马人被扣押进行法医鉴定。

sentences.en: Photographs of the Jeep were compared to the vehicle caught travelling from Henrietta to Dolmar the night of the attack.
sentences.zh: 吉普车的照片被拿来与袭击当晚从亨丽埃塔开往德尔马的车辆进行比对。

sentences.en: They were a match.
sentences.zh: 结果吻合。

sentences.en: Marshall, who had sighted the Jeep in the Porco's driveway, also identified it as Chris Porco's car.
sentences.zh: 曾在波尔科家车道上看到过这辆吉普车的马歇尔，也认出这就是克里斯·波尔科的车。

sentences.en: Henrietta was a suburb of the city of Rochester, where Chris studied.
sentences.zh: 亨丽埃塔是罗切斯特市的一个郊区，克里斯在那里上学。

sentences.en: In a fortunate break for detectives, new security cameras had been installed throughout the exterior of the campus, including the car parks.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，侦探们发现校园外围，包括停车场，新安装了监控摄像头。

sentences.en: They examined 880 hours of footage, during which Chris's yellow Jeep Wrangler was filmed leaving the campus at 10.30pm on November 14, hours before the attack.
sentences.zh: 他们检查了880小时的录像，发现克里斯的黄色吉普牧马人在11月14日晚上10点30分，即袭击发生前几小时离开了校园。

sentences.en: This timing aligned with the 15 minutes it took the vehicle to travel to the Exit 46 toll booth, where the Jeep was captured on camera and witnessed by toll collector John Fallon.
sentences.zh: 这个时间与车辆行驶到46号出口收费站所需的15分钟相吻合，在那里，吉普车被摄像头拍到，并被收费员约翰·法伦目击。

sentences.en: It then drove near 3 hours east towards Delmar, before Karen Russell at Exit 24 centred onwards from her toll booth.
sentences.zh: 随后它向东行驶了近3小时前往德尔马，之后凯伦·拉塞尔在24号出口的收费站看到了它继续前行。

sentences.en: At 8.30am, Chris's Jeep was filmed pulling into the University of Rochester car park.
sentences.zh: 早上8点30分，克里斯的吉普车被拍到驶入罗切斯特大学停车场。

sentences.en: Shortly thereafter, Chris was sighted by another student wearing a baseball cap and slowly jogging towards his dormitory.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，另一名学生看到克里斯戴着棒球帽，正缓慢地慢跑向他的宿舍。

sentences.en: At 10am, a fellow resident saw him sleeping on the common room sofa.
sentences.zh: 上午10点，一位住校同学看到他在公共休息室的沙发上睡觉。

sentences.en: An electronic easy pass tag was found on the floor of Chris's Jeep.
sentences.zh: 在克里斯吉普车的地板上发现了一个电子自动缴费标签。

sentences.en: This would have enabled him to drive through the toll booths without having to stop and pay cash.
sentences.zh: 这本可以让他无需停车付现金就能通过收费站。

sentences.en: It was suspected he had removed it from its usual position on the windshield, and opted for the manual ticketed toll system to avoid being digitally tracked.
sentences.zh: 据怀疑，他从挡风玻璃的常规位置取下了它，并选择人工缴费系统，以避免被数字化追踪。

sentences.en: In another lucky break for investigators, the toll tickets collected on the night of the attack hadn't yet been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 调查人员的另一个幸运之处是，袭击当晚收取的通行费票据尚未销毁。

sentences.en: One contained mitochondrial DNA that undisputedly linked it to Chris.
sentences.zh: 其中一张票据上含有线粒体DNA，毫无疑问地将其与克里斯联系了起来。

sentences.en: While the Porco's home security system had been smashed, its records revealed it had first been disarmed using the master code.
sentences.zh: 虽然波尔科家的家庭安防系统被砸毁，但记录显示它是先被使用主密码解除武装的。

sentences.en: Chris was one of only six people who knew the code.
sentences.zh: 克里斯是仅有的六个知道密码的人之一。

sentences.en: Police suspected that he smashed the system's screen to fool them into thinking that the intruder had disarmed the device this way.
sentences.zh: 警方怀疑他砸碎了系统的屏幕，是为了误导他们，让他们以为入侵者是用这种方式解除设备的。

sentences.en: They also suspected he had worn a pair of scrubs obtained from his time working in the veterinary clinic to avoid soiling his clothes with his parents' blood.
sentences.zh: 他们还怀疑他穿了一套从兽医诊所工作时弄来的手术服，以避免衣服沾上父母的血迹。

sentences.en: His extensive work in cleaning up after veterinary procedures would have given him ample skills to clean up a bloody crime scene and any staining in his car.
sentences.zh: 他在兽医手术后清理工作的丰富经验，使他有足够的能力清理血腥的犯罪现场以及车内的任何污渍。

sentences.en: In a final blow to Chris's professions of innocence, the fingerprint on the basement door was matched to his own.
sentences.zh: 对克里斯无罪辩护的最后一击是，地下室门上的指纹与他本人的指纹相符。

sentences.en: Despite Joan Porco refuting that she had implicated her son in the immediate aftermath of her attack,
sentences.zh: 尽管琼·波尔科否认她在遇袭后立即指控了自己的儿子，

sentences.en: Detective Bowdish remained firm that Chris Porco was responsible.
sentences.zh: 但鲍迪什警探坚信克里斯·波尔科难辞其咎。
zh_words: 克里斯·波尔科难辞其咎

sentences.en: He recalled the time he visited the Porco residence years prior to investigate the matter of the two stolen laptops.
sentences.zh: 他回想起几年前曾因两台笔记本电脑被盗一事走访过波尔科家。

sentences.en: Although the house had all the hallmarks of a burglary, Bowdish was certain the crime scene was staged.
sentences.zh: 虽然那所房子有所有入室盗窃的特征，但鲍迪什确信犯罪现场是伪造的。

sentences.en: His suspicions only increased after the axe attack.
sentences.zh: 斧头袭击事件发生后，他的怀疑加深了。

sentences.en: Similar to the laptop robbery, a mesh window screen had been slashed in the garage, indicating the intruder's entry point.
sentences.zh: 和笔记本电脑失窃案类似，车库里的一个纱窗被割开了，显示了入侵者的进入点。

sentences.en: However, the garage window had since been bolted shut and was also covered in cobwebs.
sentences.zh: 然而，车库窗户后来被锁死了，上面还覆盖着蜘蛛网。

sentences.en: It was clear no one had come through there and that the mesh had been cut from the inside.
sentences.zh: 很明显，没有人从那里进来，纱窗是从里面割开的。

sentences.en: Shortly before his parents were attacked, Chris Porco attempted to sell a laptop he stole from a friend.
sentences.zh: 在父母遇袭前不久，克里斯·波尔科曾试图出售一台从朋友那里偷来的笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: Furthermore, just prior to the attack on Peter and Joan, the veterinary clinic Chris previously worked for reported some electronic devices and a cell phone had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 此外，就在彼得和琼遇袭前，克里斯之前工作的兽医诊所报告称一些电子设备和一部手机被盗。

sentences.en: The intruder had staged the scene at the veterinary clinic to look like a break-in by shattering a window.
sentences.zh: 入侵者通过打碎窗户，将兽医诊所的现场伪造成入室盗窃。

sentences.en: They had disarmed the alarm and reactivated it after stealing the goods.
sentences.zh: 他们在偷走财物后解除了警报，并重新激活了它。

sentences.en: The clinic's cell phone was later found in the Porco family safe.
sentences.zh: 诊所的手机后来在波尔科家的保险箱里被发现。

sentences.en: This was the beginning of an elaborate web of lies surrounding Chris Porco.
sentences.zh: 这是围绕克里斯·波尔科编织的复杂谎言网的开端。

sentences.en: His family were never wealthy like he boasted to friends, and he didn't have over $2 million in an offshore bank account.
sentences.zh: 他的家庭并不像他向朋友吹嘘的那样富有，他在海外银行账户里也没有超过200万美元的存款。

sentences.en: According to the CBS 48 Hours documentary Memory of Murder, every time Chris' friends asked to see the mansion he claimed to have purchased in North Carolina,
sentences.zh: 据哥伦比亚广播公司《48小时》纪录片《谋杀记忆》记载，每当克里斯的朋友要求看他声称在北卡罗来纳州购买的豪宅时，

sentences.en: he came up with an excuse as to why he couldn't take them.
sentences.zh: 他总能编出借口，解释为什么不能带他们去。

sentences.en: When he took them on tours to view his lavish childhood homestead, they suspected he was pointing out a random house he'd never lived in.
sentences.zh: 当他带他们参观他那奢华的童年故居时，他们怀疑他指的只是一栋他从未住过的随机房子。

sentences.en: They found Chris' stories exaggerated and hard to believe, but he did always seem to have cash on him and was, quote, such a lovely guy that they gave him the benefit of the doubt.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得克里斯的故事夸大其词，难以置信，但他似乎总是有现金，而且，引用他们的话说，他是个“如此可爱的人”，以至于他们还是选择相信他。

sentences.en: These lies seemed relatively harmless and only served as a means for Chris to grandstand his otherwise ordinary life.
sentences.zh: 这些谎言看起来相对无害，只是克里斯用来为他本平凡的生活撑场面的手段。

sentences.en: However, there was one lie that hinted at a deeper problem Chris had with confronting the reality of his life decisions.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一个谎言暗示了克里斯在面对生活抉择的现实时存在更深层的问题。

sentences.en: According to his friends, rather than having a bout of glandular fever that set back his studies,
sentences.zh: 据他的朋友说，他并没有患上腺热病导致学业受阻，

sentences.en: Chris often skipped classes due to partying and excessive drinking.
sentences.zh: 克里斯经常因为聚会和酗酒而逃课。

sentences.en: After being asked to leave the University of Rochester due to poor performance,
sentences.zh: 在因成绩不佳被要求离开罗切斯特大学后，

sentences.en: Chris enrolled in community college, but once again failed to attend.
sentences.zh: 克里斯注册了社区学院，但再次未能坚持上课。

sentences.en: Not wanting his parents to find out, he lied to them, telling them he passed and had been accepted back into the University of Rochester.
sentences.zh: 为了不让父母发现，他向他们撒谎，说自己通过了考试，并已被罗切斯特大学重新录取。

sentences.en: In reality, Chris forged a fake transcript, giving himself three A's and a B to get back into university.
sentences.zh: 实际上，克里斯伪造了一份成绩单，给自己打了三个A和一个B，以便重返大学。

sentences.en: When he returned, Chris told his parents that he'd never failed any subjects in the first place, but had mistakenly been asked to leave after a professor lost an exam he had taken.
sentences.zh: 当他回去时，克里斯告诉父母，他一开始并没有挂科，只是因为一位教授弄丢了他的试卷，才被误要求离开。

sentences.en: Chris told Peter and Joan that to make up for the mistake, the University offered to pay the tuition fees for a full semester.
sentences.zh: 克里斯告诉彼得和琼，为了弥补这个错误，大学主动提出支付他整个学期的学费。

sentences.en: This was a complete lie.
sentences.zh: 这完全是谎言。

sentences.en: On October 7, 2004, six weeks before the attack,
sentences.zh: 2004年10月7日，即袭击发生前六周，

sentences.en: Chris asked his father for help to secure a $2,000 loan to pay for some school expenses.
sentences.zh: 克里斯向父亲寻求帮助，申请一笔2000美元的贷款来支付一些学费。

sentences.en: Peter agreed and sent personal information to Chris so he could become a co-signatory.
sentences.zh: 彼得同意了，并将个人信息发给克里斯，以便他成为共同签署人。

sentences.en: Instead, Chris used this information to secure a $31,000 loan and forged his father's signature on the application.
sentences.zh: 相反，克里斯利用这些信息申请了一笔31000美元的贷款，并在申请表上伪造了他父亲的签名。

sentences.en: Peter discovered this when a letter arrived at his house informing him that the loan had been approved.
sentences.zh: 彼得在收到一封通知他贷款已获批准的信件时发现了这一点。

sentences.en: Furious, Peter rang the bank and cancelled the loan.
sentences.zh: 彼得大发雷霆，打电话给银行取消了贷款。

sentences.en: He then rang the University of Rochester Finance Department, who assured Peter that the university was not paying for Chris's semester of tuition.
sentences.zh: 随后，他致电罗切斯特大学财务部，对方确认大学并未支付克里斯该学期的学费。

sentences.en: As a result, Peter paid for the tuition himself.
sentences.zh: 结果，彼得自己支付了学费。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, Chris showed up to visit his parents in a brand new yellow Jeep Wrangler.
sentences.zh: 几周后，克里斯开着一辆崭新的黄色吉普牧马人来看望父母。

sentences.en: He told them it had been gifted to him in exchange for some used computers.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，这是他用一些旧电脑换来的礼物。

sentences.en: In reality, Chris had forged his father's signature to obtain a loan for the amount of $16,450 to purchase the Jeep.
sentences.zh: 实际上，克里斯伪造了他父亲的签名，申请了一笔16450美元的贷款来购买这辆吉普车。

sentences.en: In good faith, Peter agreed to remain co-signatory on the loan, allowing Chris to keep the car.
sentences.zh: 出于好意，彼得同意继续作为贷款的共同签署人，让克里斯留下了这辆车。

sentences.en: However, Chris soon fell behind in the loan repayments.
sentences.zh: 然而，克里斯很快就拖欠了贷款还款。

sentences.en: Ten days before the attack, Peter emailed Chris explaining that he needed to pay for the outstanding repayments to avoid their credit ratings being adversely affected.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生前十天，彼得给克里斯发了一封电子邮件，解释说他需要支付逾期还款，以免他们的信用评级受到不利影响。

sentences.en: The email ended.
sentences.zh: 邮件结尾写道：

sentences.en: Mum's been trying to email you, but you have not answered.
sentences.zh: 妈妈一直在尝试给你发邮件，但你没有回复。

sentences.en: You have a lot of explaining to do.
sentences.zh: 你有很多事情要解释。

sentences.en: It's time to stop the bullshit and call me right away.
sentences.zh: 是时候停止胡扯，立刻给我打电话了。

sentences.en: Shortly after, Peter sent another email explaining that he'd reluctantly paid the loan repayments for Chris.
sentences.zh: 不久后，彼得又发了一封邮件，解释说他勉强为克里斯支付了贷款还款。

sentences.en: He wrote,
sentences.zh: 他写道：

sentences.en: I want you to know that if you abuse my credit again, I will be forced to file forgery affidavits in order to disclaim liability.
sentences.zh: 我想让你知道，如果你再次滥用我的信用，我将被迫提交伪造宣誓书，以声明免除责任。

sentences.en: One week before the attack, Chris still hadn't contacted his parents.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生前一周，克里斯仍然没有联系他的父母。

sentences.en: Joan sent him an email that read,
sentences.zh: 琼给他发了一封邮件，写道：

sentences.en: Dad and I are very upset about your not communicating with us.
sentences.zh: 爸爸和我对你不与我们沟通感到非常难过。

sentences.en: We don't know if you are well or mentally stable.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道你是否健康或精神稳定。

sentences.en: Dad is about to have a nervous breakdown.
sentences.zh: 爸爸快要精神崩溃了。

sentences.en: Do you understand that you are not behaving responsibly?
sentences.zh: 你明白你的行为很不负责任吗？

sentences.en: For God's sakes, call.
sentences.zh: 看在上帝的份上，打个电话吧。

sentences.en: Detectives worked on the theory that these ongoing financial issues were what motivated Chris to launch the brutal attack on his parents.
sentences.zh: 侦探们推测，正是这些持续不断的经济问题促使克里斯对父母发动了残酷的袭击。

sentences.en: On the morning of the crime, his bank accounts were overdrawn by $117.
sentences.zh: 案发当天早上，他的银行账户透支了117美元。

sentences.en: But, just weeks prior, he had visited a financial advisor and said he was about to receive millions of dollars from a relative.
sentences.zh: 但是，就在几周前，他曾拜访过一位财务顾问，声称自己即将从一位亲戚那里获得数百万美元。

sentences.en: He requested that a portfolio be drawn up.
sentences.zh: 他要求制定一份投资组合。

sentences.en: Detectives believed Chris didn't want to give up the lavish lifestyle he had falsely created for himself and would go to great lengths to maintain it,
sentences.zh: 侦探们认为，克里斯不想放弃他虚构出来的奢华生活，并会不惜一切代价维持它，

sentences.en: killing his parents for their life insurance policies.
sentences.zh: 甚至为了人寿保险金而杀害父母。

sentences.en: On November 4, 2005, almost a year after Peter and Joan Porco were attacked,
sentences.zh: 2005年11月4日，在彼得和琼·波尔科遇袭近一年后，

sentences.en: Chris Porco was formally arrested for the crime.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·波尔科因该罪行被正式逮捕。

sentences.en: A grand jury indicted him for the second-degree murder of his father and attempted murder of his mother.
sentences.zh: 大陪审团以二级谋杀父亲和谋杀母亲未遂的罪名起诉了他。

sentences.en: He appeared calm and collected as he was led from the courtroom in handcuffs and taken into custody to await a bail hearing set for two weeks' time.
sentences.zh: 当他戴着手铐被带出法庭并被拘留，等待两周后的保释听证会时，他显得冷静而镇定。

sentences.en: The upcoming trial presented an unusual problem for the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 即将到来的审判给检方带来了一个不同寻常的问题。

sentences.en: District Attorney David Soares told reporters,
sentences.zh: 地方检察官大卫·苏亚雷斯告诉记者：

sentences.en: Ultimately, the issue here is in order to get justice for Joan Porco, we have to find her son guilty.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这里的问题是，为了给琼·波尔科伸张正义，我们必须判定她的儿子有罪。

sentences.en: This was regardless of whether it came with Joan's blessing.
sentences.zh: 无论这是否得到了琼的祝福。

sentences.en: Joan fully supported her son to be released on bail pending trial.
sentences.zh: 琼完全支持她的儿子在审判前获得保释。

sentences.en: In a letter to the judge, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 在给法官的一封信中，她写道：

sentences.en: Even though I am still in the process of recovering from the attack, I have had many occasions to be with Chris.
sentences.zh: 尽管我仍在从袭击中恢复，但我有很多机会与克里斯在一起。

sentences.en: During all of those times, he has been the same loving person that Peter and I raised and continues to treat me with the same respect that he showed before the attack.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些时间里，他依然是彼得和我抚养长大的那个充满爱心的人，并继续以袭击前表现出的同样尊重对待我。

sentences.en: Family and friends managed to collect $250,000 cash to meet Chris's bail requirements.
sentences.zh: 家人和朋友设法筹集了25万美元现金，以满足克里斯的保释要求。

sentences.en: He walked from the courthouse flashing a smile at reporters, who asked how he was doing.
sentences.zh: 他走出法院，向询问他近况的记者露出了微笑。

sentences.en: He replied,
sentences.zh: 他回答说：

sentences.en: I feel pretty good actually, and I just want you to know, I'm innocent.
sentences.zh: 我感觉其实挺好的，我只想让你们知道，我是无辜的。

sentences.en: Chris spent the following weekend at a hotel with his mother, who was delighted to see him.
sentences.zh: 克里斯随后的周末是在一家酒店与母亲度过的，母亲见到他非常高兴。

sentences.en: While awaiting trial, he spent his time going to clubs in downtown Albany, where he had become somewhat of a celebrity due to the extensive local reporting on the case.
sentences.zh: 在等待审判期间，他花时间去奥尔巴尼市中心的俱乐部，由于当地对该案的大量报道，他已成为某种意义上的名人。

sentences.en: Girls asked to have their photo taken with him, eager to show friends they had met the man accused of murder.
sentences.zh: 女孩们要求与他合影，急于向朋友炫耀她们见到了那个被控谋杀的人。

sentences.en: On June 27, 2006, Chris Porco arrived at the Orange County Courthouse, accompanied by his mother.
sentences.zh: 2006年6月27日，克里斯·波尔科在母亲的陪同下抵达奥兰治县法院。

sentences.en: The venue had been changed from Albany after his attorneys successfully argued he wouldn't get a fair trial in his home county, due to the extensive media interest in the case.
sentences.zh: 由于他的律师成功辩称，由于媒体对该案的广泛关注，他在家乡县无法获得公正的审判，因此审判地点已从奥尔巴尼更改。

sentences.en: Chris held an umbrella out for Joan as they walked into the courthouse arm in arm.
sentences.zh: 当他们挽着手走进法院时，克里斯为琼撑着伞。

sentences.en: Joan looked thin and frail next to her tall and strapping son.
sentences.zh: 在身材高大魁梧的儿子身边，琼显得瘦弱而虚弱。

sentences.en: She wore large, dark sunglasses that hid the glass eye and some of the scarring to her face she had received from the attack.
sentences.zh: 她戴着一副大大的深色墨镜，遮住了袭击留下的义眼和脸部的一些疤痕。

sentences.en: Despite her efforts to remain relatively inconspicuous, Joan was a major focus in her son's trial.
sentences.zh: 尽管她努力保持低调，但琼仍然是她儿子审判中的焦点。

sentences.en: The defence argued that she couldn't have identified Chris as her attacker as it was too dark in the bedroom when the assault took place.
sentences.zh: 辩方辩称，她不可能认出克里斯是袭击者，因为袭击发生时卧室里太黑了。

sentences.en: They also argued that Joan's cognitive abilities should have been assessed before Detective Bowdish questioned her in the bedroom to make sure she understood what was being asked.
sentences.zh: 他们还辩称，在鲍迪什警探在卧室审问琼之前，应该先评估她的认知能力，以确保她理解所问的问题。

sentences.en: Even though Joan denied implicating her son, multiple paramedics were present in the bedroom when Bowdish questioned her.
sentences.zh: 尽管琼否认指控自己的儿子，但鲍迪什审问她时，卧室里有多名医护人员在场。

sentences.en: They all verified his version of events.
sentences.zh: 他们都证实了他的说法。

sentences.en: Joan had agreed Chris was her assailant.
sentences.zh: 琼确实承认了克里斯是袭击者。

sentences.en: The defence also highlighted Joan's story of having seen a stranger in her driveway two weeks before the attack.
sentences.zh: 辩方还强调了琼关于在袭击发生前两周看到陌生人在她车道上的说法。

sentences.en: They were critical of the police for not investigating this incident at the time, suggesting Detective Bowdish in particular was sloppy in his work.
sentences.zh: 他们批评警方当时没有调查这一事件，并暗示鲍迪什警探的工作尤其草率。

sentences.en: The prosecution called the defence's claim of shoddy police work preposterous,
sentences.zh: 检方称辩方关于警方工作草率的说法荒谬可笑，

sentences.en: revealing that over 200 neighbours in the vicinity of the Porco house were interviewed after the crime.
sentences.zh: 并透露案发后对波尔科家附近的200多名邻居进行了采访。

sentences.en: But the police were not entirely without fault.
sentences.zh: 但警方并非完全没有过错。

sentences.en: The trial judge established that the interview conducted with Chris on the day of the attack was inadmissible, due to the errors made in not reading Chris his Miranda rights.
sentences.zh: 审判法官裁定，由于在未宣读米兰达权利方面存在错误，案发当天对克里斯进行的审讯不可采信。

sentences.en: Silence filled the courtroom as Peter and Joan's eldest son, Jonathan Porco, took the stand, avoiding eye contact with his brother.
sentences.zh: 当彼得和琼的长子乔纳森·波尔科走上证人席时，法庭内一片寂静，他避免与弟弟进行眼神交流。

sentences.en: While he initially stood by Chris, John admitted that he and Chris had a strange relationship.
sentences.zh: 虽然他最初支持克里斯，但约翰承认他和克里斯的关系很奇怪。

sentences.en: He didn't elaborate any further.
sentences.zh: 他没有再多做解释。

sentences.en: John also revealed that they were both aware they stood to inherit over $1 million in life insurance and benefits in the event of their parents' death.
sentences.zh: 约翰还透露，他们都知道如果父母去世，他们将继承超过100万美元的人寿保险和福利。

sentences.en: When photos of the critically injured Joan were flashed on a courtroom screen, Chris Porco removed his glasses to wipe away tears.
sentences.zh: 当琼受重伤的照片在法庭屏幕上闪过时，克里斯·波尔科摘下眼镜擦去了泪水。

sentences.en: The photos were so graphic that the judge ordered them to be shown in black and white rather than colour.
sentences.zh: 照片内容太过血腥，法官下令将照片处理成黑白而非彩色展示。

sentences.en: During breaks, Joan often went over to embrace Chris and the two were seen smiling together.
sentences.zh: 休庭期间，琼经常走过去拥抱克里斯，两人被看到在一起微笑。

sentences.en: After 85 witnesses and 450 pieces of evidence were presented,
sentences.zh: 在展示了85名证人和450件证据后，

sentences.en: the defence team contended that the prosecution hadn't proved its case due to a circumstantial timeline of events and a lack of forensic evidence.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队辩称，由于事件的时间线纯属推测，且缺乏法医证据，检方并未证实其指控。

sentences.en: They cited that no blood or DNA was found in the house to link Chris to the crimes.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，屋内没有发现任何能将克里斯与罪行联系起来的血迹或DNA。

sentences.en: The one thing placing Chris in the house, his fingerprint on the basement door, could be easily explained by his multiple visits to the home prior to the crime.
sentences.zh: 唯一能证明克里斯在屋内的证据——他在地下室门上的指纹，完全可以用他案发前多次来访来解释。

sentences.en: On August 10, the jury left the courtroom to decide Chris Porco's fate.
sentences.zh: 8月10日，陪审团离开法庭，决定克里斯·波尔科的命运。

sentences.en: While they were deliberating, reporters asked Chris what he would tell the jury members if he had the chance.
sentences.zh: 在他们商议期间，记者问克里斯，如果有机会，他会对陪审团成员说些什么。

sentences.en: Chris urged them not to jump to conclusions, saying,
sentences.zh: 克里斯敦促他们不要妄下结论，说道：

sentences.en: Once you look at the whole picture, I think it's pretty clear that things just don't add up.
sentences.zh: 一旦你看清了全貌，我认为很明显，事情根本对不上号。

sentences.en: Deliberation was expected to be a long and drawn-out process.
sentences.zh: 原本预计商议过程会漫长而拖沓。

sentences.en: But six hours in, the jury shocked everyone by returning to the courtroom with a verdict.
sentences.zh: 但仅过了六小时，陪审团就带着裁决结果回到法庭，令所有人大吃一惊。

sentences.en: Anticipating a lengthy deliberation, Joan Porco had retired to rest in her nearby hotel room and wasn't present when the verdict was announced.
sentences.zh: 由于预料到商议会很漫长，琼·波尔科回到附近的酒店休息，裁决宣布时她并不在场。

sentences.en: For the second-degree murder of his father Peter and the attempted murder of his mother Joan, Chris Porco was found guilty.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·波尔科因二级谋杀其父彼得以及谋杀其母琼未遂，被判有罪。

sentences.en: He remained calm as the verdict was read, but his nonchalant attitude was betrayed by his face, which turned bright red.
sentences.zh: 宣读裁决时他保持冷静，但他那满不在乎的态度被他涨红的脸出卖了。

sentences.en: Despite winning a conviction, the chief assistant district attorney said there was no cause for celebration, as, quote,
sentences.zh: 尽管赢得了定罪，首席助理地方检察官表示这没什么值得庆祝的，因为，引用他的话：

sentences.en: The whole thing is a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是一场悲剧。

sentences.en: Peter's sister Patty expressed a sense of relief, telling the media that their next challenge would be to pick up the pieces and try to rebuild as a family.
sentences.zh: 彼得的妹妹帕蒂表达了一种解脱感，她告诉媒体，他们接下来的挑战是收拾残局，努力重建家庭。

sentences.en: Two months later, Chris appeared at the Albany County Courthouse for sentencing.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，克里斯出现在奥尔巴尼县法院接受判刑。

sentences.en: While Joan asked for leniency towards her son, Patty read a victim impact statement that said,
sentences.zh: 虽然琼请求对她儿子宽大处理，但帕蒂宣读了一份受害者影响陈述，其中写道：

sentences.en: This act was the coldest, most barbaric act any human being can commit against another.
sentences.zh: 这种行为是一个人对另一个人所能做出的最冷酷、最野蛮的行为。

sentences.en: I am so angry that my future with my brother has been taken away, and especially that after giving years of his life for others,
sentences.zh: 我非常愤怒，因为我和哥哥的未来被剥夺了，尤其是他多年来为他人付出，

sentences.en: he did not get to live out his own dreams and potential.
sentences.zh: 却没能实现他自己的梦想和潜能。

sentences.en: A letter from Peter's mother was also read out to the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 法庭上还宣读了一封来自彼得母亲的信。

sentences.en: In it, she said,
sentences.zh: 信中她写道：

sentences.en: I do not fully understand what happened to my grandson, and I hope and I pray that he can be cured.
sentences.zh: 我不完全理解我的孙子身上发生了什么，我希望并祈祷他能被治愈。

sentences.en: But unless that happens, he must not be allowed to kill again.
sentences.zh: 但除非这种情况发生，否则绝不能让他再次杀人。

sentences.en: Chris blamed the police for taking a minor dispute with his father out of context and using it to incriminate him in his murder.
sentences.zh: 克里斯指责警方将他与父亲之间的小纠纷断章取义，并利用它来陷害他谋杀父亲。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: I was never able to say goodbye to my dad before he was taken from us.
sentences.zh: 在父亲被夺走之前，我甚至没能和他告别。

sentences.en: The idea that he was disappointed in me before he died will always haunt me.
sentences.zh: 他死前对我感到失望的想法将永远困扰着我。

sentences.en: The judge turned to Chris to deliver his sentence.
sentences.zh: 法官转向克里斯进行宣判。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用他的话：

sentences.en: It is very understandable to me that she feels the police didn't do enough.
sentences.zh: 我非常理解她觉得警方做得不够。

sentences.en: That's because it would be the most difficult thing in the world for a parent to believe that their child, who she gave birth to and raised and took care of,
sentences.zh: 那是因为对于一位母亲来说，要相信她亲生、抚养并照顾大的孩子，

sentences.en: would be capable of being the perpetrator of these violent, heinous acts.
sentences.zh: 竟然有能力犯下这些暴力、令人发指的罪行，这绝对是世界上最困难的事情。

sentences.en: In sentencing you today, I've got to explain to you and make you understand that the sentence that's being imposed upon you
sentences.zh: 今天在对你判刑时，我必须向你解释并让你明白，对你施加的刑罚

sentences.en: is because I fear very much that what happened is something that could happen again.
sentences.zh: 是因为我非常担心所发生的事情可能会再次发生。

sentences.en: Despite Joan's plea that Chris be freed within her lifetime, he was given the maximum sentence of 50 years to life imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 尽管琼恳求在有生之年释放克里斯，但他还是被判处了50年至终身监禁的最高刑罚。

sentences.en: Chris went on to appeal his conviction twice, but was rejected both times on grounds of there being overwhelming evidence to support his conviction.
sentences.zh: 克里斯随后两次上诉，但均因有压倒性的证据支持定罪而被驳回。

sentences.en: He then appealed to the US Supreme Court, but in April 2012, it was announced the court wouldn't be hearing his case, putting an end to Chris's appeals process.
sentences.zh: 他随后向美国最高法院上诉，但在2012年4月，法院宣布不会审理此案，终结了克里斯的上诉程序。

sentences.en: Chris attempted to sue the Lifetime Entertainment Network after they made a TV movie about the case titled
sentences.zh: 克里斯试图起诉Lifetime娱乐电视网，因为他们制作了一部关于此案的电视电影，片名为

sentences.en: Romeo Killer – The Chris Porco Story.
sentences.zh: 《罗密欧杀手：克里斯·波尔科的故事》。

sentences.en: Chris tried to put a halt to the advertising and airing of the movie, claiming that the film wrongfully used his name, likeness and personality.
sentences.zh: 克里斯试图阻止该片的广告和播出，声称该片错误地使用了他的姓名、肖像和人格。

sentences.en: While temporarily successful, the lawsuit was eventually tossed and the film was marketed as the movie Chris Porco doesn't want you to see.
sentences.zh: 虽然暂时成功，但诉讼最终被驳回，该片被宣传为“克里斯·波尔科不想让你看到的电影”。

sentences.en: It aired in March 2013 to lukewarm reviews.
sentences.zh: 该片于2013年3月播出，评价平平。

sentences.en: Chris Porco still professes his innocence and has shown no remorse for the way he treated his parents.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·波尔科至今仍坚称自己无罪，对他对待父母的方式毫无悔意。

sentences.en: From his prison cell, he told 48 Hours,
sentences.zh: 他在狱中告诉《48小时》节目组：

sentences.en: With good behaviour,
sentences.zh: 如果表现良好，

sentences.en: Chris Porco will become eligible for parole in December 2052.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·波尔科将于2052年12月获得假释资格。

sentences.en: Throughout the murder trial, messages of love for Peter Porco were shared by family, friends and colleagues.
sentences.zh: 在整个谋杀案审判过程中，家人、朋友和同事们分享了对彼得·波尔科的爱。

sentences.en: When Joan testified, she told the court how hard her husband had worked as an attorney.
sentences.zh: 当琼作证时，她向法庭讲述了她丈夫作为律师工作有多么努力。

sentences.en: He'd given up his high-profile career when his children were young, taking a job as a law clerk so he could spend more time with his family.
sentences.zh: 他在孩子们还小的时候就放弃了高调的职业生涯，找了一份法律助理的工作，以便能花更多时间陪伴家人。

sentences.en: Although it came with a pay cut,
sentences.zh: 虽然这意味着减薪，

sentences.en: Joan was pleased with the change, as it brought a sense of closeness to the Porco household.
sentences.zh: 但琼对这一改变感到高兴，因为它给波尔科家带来了亲密感。

sentences.en: Joan and Peter had celebrated their 30-year wedding anniversary just five months before the attack, during which Joan said her family had been as close as ever.
sentences.zh: 琼和彼得在案发前五个月刚庆祝了结婚30周年纪念日，琼说当时她的家庭一如既往地亲密。

sentences.en: It was a statement echoed by Jonathan Porco, who said,
sentences.zh: 乔纳森·波尔科也表达了同样的看法，他说：

sentences.en: When the crime scene at the Porco's home was first examined, an investigator came across a cashier's check Peter had signed for overdue parking fees accumulated by Chris.
sentences.zh: 当波尔科家案发现场首次被勘查时，调查人员发现了一张彼得签名的现金支票，用于支付克里斯拖欠的停车费。

sentences.en: A smear of blood in one of the corners indicated that even after being viciously assaulted by Chris,
sentences.zh: 角落里的一抹血迹表明，即使在被克里斯残忍袭击后，

sentences.en: Peter was still trying to help his son get out of trouble.
sentences.zh: 彼得仍在试图帮助他的儿子摆脱困境。

sentences.en: Despite having been lied to time and time again and threatened with financial ruin, one of the last emails Peter sent to Chris was a testament to the type of father he truly was.
sentences.zh: 尽管一次又一次地被欺骗并面临经济崩溃的威胁，彼得发给克里斯的最后一封电子邮件之一，证明了他究竟是怎样的一位父亲。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 信中写道：

sentences.en: Things are obviously spinning out of control with you.
sentences.zh: 你的事情显然已经失控了。

sentences.en: I think you should come home so we can talk.
sentences.zh: 我想你应该回家，这样我们谈谈。

sentences.en: We may be disappointed in you, but your mother and I still love you and care about your future.
sentences.zh: 我们可能对你感到失望，但我和你母亲依然爱你，关心你的未来。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 走吧。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 走吧。

sentences.en: Let's go.
sentences.zh: 走吧。
